# Plug.Cowboy v2.9.0 - Table of Contents

> A Plug adapter for Cowboy

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://plug-cowboy.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Plug.Cowboy](https://plug-cowboy.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Cowboy.md): Adapter interface to the [Cowboy webserver](https://github.com/ninenines/cowboy).
- [Plug.Cowboy.Drainer](https://plug-cowboy.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Cowboy.Drainer.md): Process to drain cowboy connections at shutdown.
